Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to store multiple lines of text as prompt column output to enable makers to save longer and more detailed AI-generated insights in Dataverse tables. This feature will reach general availability on November 16, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Once available, new prompt columns will include multiple lines of text as an output option. Existing prompt columns will continue to work as expected but will not have this option.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Prompt Columns.

Title: Dataverse - Prompt columns support multiple lines of text output
